hook.explorer: Press the button, make the light go!
hook.builder: Add a button so you can turn your light on and off.
hook.engineer: Insert a momentary switch into the series loop and reason about where it has to go.

instruction.builder: Start from your First Light circuit, but leave out the last wire to the black rail.
instruction.engineer: Rebuild the First Light series loop, omitting the final return jumper.

instruction.explorer: Push the button in so it sits over the middle line.
instruction.builder: Push the button into the board so its legs straddle the centre channel, at rows 18 and 20.
instruction.engineer: Straddle the centre channel with the tactile switch - legs into F18/F20 and the mirrored pair. Straddling is what keeps the two internal pairs on separate nets.

explanation.explorer: The button is a gate for the zap.
explanation.builder: A button is just a gap in the wire that you close with your finger.
explanation.engineer: The switch's two leg pairs are permanently joined within each pair; pressing bridges the pairs. Straddling the channel is essential, or you short a pair to itself and the button does nothing.

instruction.explorer: Two more wires, then press it!
instruction.builder: Run one jumper from E15 to G18, and another from G20 to the black rail.
instruction.engineer: Jumper row 15 to one side of the switch, and the other side to the negative bus.

expect.explorer: Press it! Light! Let go! Dark!
expect.builder: The LED lights only while you hold the button down.
expect.engineer: Momentary action - the loop is closed only while the switch is held.

bigIdea.explorer: A button opens and closes the circle.
bigIdea.builder: A switch is just a controllable gap in the loop. It works anywhere in the loop, not just next to the light.
bigIdea.engineer: In a series circuit the switch's position is electrically irrelevant - the same current flows everywhere. Position is a matter of convention and safety, not function.

goFurther.explorer: Move the button somewhere else. Does it still work?
goFurther.builder: Try moving the button to the other side of the LED. Does it still work? Why?
goFurther.engineer: Move the switch between the battery and the resistor. Predict whether behaviour changes, then verify.
